title: Two tests that report green without testing anything: env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig has 9 assertion-free blocks, entity_subsystem_test.zig is built but attached to no step
symptom:
Two distinct ways a test can report green while testing nothing, both found while clearing ISS-0137's unwired backlog.

(A) tests/integration/env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig is an UNFINISHED codegen scaffold. It has 9 `test` blocks and 20 `// CUSTOM:` placeholder comments, and ZERO calls to std.testing.expect* of any kind. Each block builds a TestHarness, calls setup(), discards the fixtures with `_ = fx`, and ends. The intended SQL for each case exists only as a comment. Now that GH #439 has wired it in, it contributes 9 passing tests that assert nothing.

(B) tests/integration/entity_subsystem_test.zig is compiled into an addTest artifact (`exp_integration_tests`, build.zig) and a Run artifact is created for it (`run_exp_integration_tests`), but that Run step is attached to NO build step — not `test_integration_others_step`, not any narrow step. It is built and never executed. It is invisible to tools/lint_test_wiring.py because that linter checks addTest REACHABILITY, not whether the resulting Run artifact is attached to a step.
root_cause:
(A) The codegen scaffold from tools/codegen_migration.py was committed with its `// CUSTOM:` blocks unfilled and never completed. It was invisible because the file was wired into no build target (ISS-0137), so it neither ran nor compiled — it also referenced std.crypto.random and a `generated.uuid()` helper that exists nowhere in the repo.

(B) An omitted `test_integration_others_step.dependOn(&run_exp_integration_tests.step)` line in build.zig. Every sibling integration target in the same region of build.zig has one; this one does not. Because the artifact still compiles, no gate notices.
reproduction:
(A) grep -c 'testing.expect' tests/integration/env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig  ->  0, against 9 `test` blocks.
(B) grep -n 'run_exp_integration_tests' build.zig  ->  the artifact is created and configured (setCwd, setEnvironmentVariable) but never appears in any dependOn() call.
impact:
Both defects are the same class ISS-0137 exists to remove — coverage that appears to exist but does not — and both survive the ISS-0137 fix, so clearing that backlog does not close them.

(A) ENV-01 appears to have 9 integration test cases covering the tenant_type/production_tenant_id CHECK constraint, the ON DELETE RESTRICT behaviour, and PATCH immutability. None of that is actually verified by this file. Genuine ENV-01 coverage does exist in tests/integration/env01_test.zig (12 blocks, 31 assertions) and is wired, so the requirement is not uncovered — but the scaffold inflates the apparent case count and will mislead anyone auditing coverage per requirement.

(B) Every test block in entity_subsystem_test.zig has never run. That file is also one of the two callers of the TestHarness.provisionTenant()/setTenant() methods that GH #439 had to implement because they were called but existed on no type — direct evidence the file has not compiled, let alone executed, for some time.
candidate_resolution:
(A) Either implement the 9 test cases (the intended SQL for each is already written out in the comments, and env01_test.zig shows the working idiom), or delete the file as superseded by env01_test.zig and record that decision. Do NOT leave it as-is: an assertion-free test file is worse than no file, because it reads as coverage. Prefer deletion if env01_test.zig's 12 blocks already cover the same acceptance criteria — check that before writing new cases.

(B) Add `test_integration_others_step.dependOn(&run_exp_integration_tests.step);` in build.zig alongside its siblings, then FIX whatever that file's tests report once they actually execute for the first time (expect failures, per the GH #428 and GH #439 precedents).

Separately, consider extending tools/lint_test_wiring.py with a second check: every `b.addRunArtifact` of a `b.addTest` result must be reachable from at least one `b.step`. That is the exact gap (B) fell through — the current linter proves a file is reachable from an addTest root, not that the root is ever run.
notes: Filed under the WF03-gh439 handoff's constraint that no discovered defect is left undocumented, and specifically NOT fixed inline: (A) is a requirements-coverage decision (implement vs. delete) that belongs to whoever owns ENV-01, and (B) will surface a fresh batch of first-time test failures that needs its own diagnose/fix cycle rather than being folded into a build-graph fix. Under GH #439 env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig was repaired only to the point of COMPILING (std.crypto.random and generated.uuid() replaced with real helpers) so that it stays wired and visible to the linter rather than being deleted or excluded to make the gate pass — making it compile deliberately does not make it cover anything, which is why this issue exists.
